name: Mt. SAC Invitational
where: Walnut, CA · host Mt. San Antonio College · Hilmer Lodge Stadium
headline: Mt. SAC Invitational
summary: Final: Crescenta Valley won the Division 1-2 boys team sweepstakes with 149 points to Beckman's 158, and Redondo Union's Mario Montoya won the race in 13:43.5 ahead of Mt. Carmel's Jaxon Northcutt (13:53.4). Northgate won the girls team sweepstakes with 107 to Mira Costa's 137, and Westlake sophomore Sabina Cruz won in 16:35.1. Ontario's Isabella Ruiz, No. 27 in DyeStat's individual rankings, ran the fastest girls time of the day, 16:22.6, to win the individual sweepstakes.
